instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with what you have learnt about handling difficult feelings.

atoms.b: Energetic coping strategies ((++keep_you_moving let_you_rest)) and take your body to a different place.
Social coping strategies make you happier by allowing you to spend time with ((++other_people hobbies)) that you like.
Self-calming coping strategies are activities that let you calm down and give you ((++the_space the_company)) you need to feel better
Attention-shifting coping strategies are ways to get your mind to ((++focus_on move_away_from)) other things that you enjoy, rather than what’s bothering you.
Organising coping strategies are things that help us feel more ((++in_control_of overwhelmed_by)) our lives by breaking our tasks into smaller steps.

instruction.text: Is this positive self talk? Decide quickly!

atoms.a: I will probably fail, so I won’t try.
I lost today, but I can have another go next week.
I disappointed everyone, and they will all talk about me.
It’s scary to talk in front of the class, but it won’t last that long and I can keep control of my nerves.
I might feel lonely at first, but I will soon get to know people and settle in.
